FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Parcel Point Solutions specializes in providing efficient mail and packaging services, including domestic and international shipping solutions. Our core operations focus on standard mail and parcel delivery services, ensuring reliability and customer satisfaction. We offer limited ancillary services, including basic printing, notary services, and retail sales of essential shipping supplies, which helps us maintain a streamlined operation and minimizes exposure to financial and regulatory risks. Our team is committed to following all local, state, and federal shipping regulations, and we prioritize security measures such as locks and surveillance cameras to safeguard our facility. We strive to train our employees thoroughly in packaging and shipping protocols, promoting a safe and efficient working environment.

Our Mail & Packaging Services offers a comprehensive range of solutions, including advanced printing services, notarization, and a full array of shipping supplies, along with custom packaging and specialized shipping options to meet diverse customer needs.
